source.title: Judicial Branch section (Table-5 cap-fit unit, page 10). Full 9-column outlays model (3 periods x Gross Outlays/Applicable Receipts/Outlays[net]). Self-contained: no cell overlaps another unit's table. Follows the family pattern in plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md; sibling worked example: 2026-05-outlays-legislative.
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted, never transcribed as 0); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' -- omitted (none appear in this section). Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, accounting negatives as a leading '-'. Nine-column model: 3 periods (This Month / Current Fiscal Year to Date / Prior Fiscal Year to Date) x (Gross Outlays / Applicable Receipts / Outlays[net]). Every declared sum foots EXACTLY (no rounding tolerances needed here). The Applicable Receipts column has a single contributing line (Proprietary Receipts from the Public), so it has no >=2-source column roll-up: the three section-total Applicable cells are covered by the total-row net identity (Total Outlays + Total Applicable = Total Gross), and the three line-level Proprietary Applicable cells are 'standalone' (relation-free within this unit) with a why. See the plan's Pattern addendum (flagship, 2026-07-14).

cells.why: Applicable Receipts on 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public', a line with no Gross Outlays (the Gross column prints '......'): Outlays(net) = -Applicable (e.g. 116 = -(-116)), but the offset has no Gross cell to target, and Proprietary is the only line carrying an Applicable value in this section, so its column has no second source for a sum roll-up. Genuinely relation-free within this unit; the section-total Applicable cell (same value) is instead covered by the total-row net identity.
